Author: lavaskin
Name: Mentor Roulette Tracker
Description:
Records each Mentor Roulette run you play: the duty, your job, whether it was cleared, whether you joined as a replacement, how many times the party wiped and your time in the duty. Connect it to your account on Mentor Roulette Tracker (mentor.lavask.in) and it logs them there for you, or keep them in the plugin and upload them later.

It only ever records the Mentor Roulette. Other roulettes, and duties you queue for yourself, are ignored.
Punchline: Logs your Mentor Roulette runs to Mentor Roulette Tracker.
Changelog:
### Changed

- A dev build of the plugin keeps its own settings and runs, apart from the installed plugin's, so trying one no longer changes the installed plugin's runs or disconnects it (#9).
